description_en: Queries the invoice information of a supplier store in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace
description_zh: 查询云市场供应商店铺的发票信息
name: DescribeInvoiceForIsv

parameters.help_en:
The current invoice status. Valid values:
- 0: processing
- 1: completed
parameters.help_zh:
当前发票状态
- 申请中：0
- 已完成：1
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The invoice type. If this parameter is left empty, all types are queried by default. Valid values:
- 2: general digital electronic invoice
- 3: special digital electronic invoice
parameters.help_zh:
发票类型，为空代表默认查询所有类型
- 数字电子普通发票：2
- 数字电子专用发票：3
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The invoice application ID. This corresponds to the Result.Id field in the response of the DescribeInvoiceForIsv operation
parameters.help_zh: 发票申请 Id（对应 DescribeInvoiceForIsv 接口返回结果中的 Result.Id）
parameters.name: invoice_id

parameters.help_en: The number of instances per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID of the customer
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time 23:59:59 is appended to the date by default
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间（日期后默认拼接23:59:59）
parameters.name: create_time_end

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time 00:00:00 is appended to the date by default
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间（日期后默认拼接00:00:00）
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10. (This parameter is not enabled.)
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为50。默认值为10。(未启用此参数)
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The query token returned by this call. (This parameter is not enabled.)
parameters.help_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值。(未启用此参数)
parameters.name: next_token
